threats.title: Account Takeover via Credential Stuffing
threats.description: An attacker submits stolen username and password pairs to the login endpoint. Gaining access lets them view customer profile data, payment methods, and order history.
threats.mitigation: Enforce Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), rate-limiting on login endpoints, and CAPTCHA after repeated failed attempts.

threats.title: Email Gateway Flooding via Order Trigger
threats.description: An attacker repeatedly triggers order confirmation requests to exhaust the outgoing mail queue, causing confirmation delays for legitimate customers.
threats.mitigation: mplement background task queues with per-user rate limiting and asynchronous processing.
